entry.title: New: Resolution 657 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — now tracked
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO THE WEST HAWAI‘I VETERANS CEMETERY DEVELOPMENT AND EXPANSION ASSOCIATION TO ASSIST WITH EXPENSES FOR THE MEDAL OF HONOR MEMORIAL

Transfers $10,000 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 9)
